//: Registry of DPAPI-encrypted secrets expected at ~/.claude/.<name>.enc. Read by deploy.ps1 and doctor.ps1. The .enc files themselves are per-user and per-machine and are NEVER synced -- each machine creates its own with Set-Secret.ps1. Add an entry here if you introduce a skill that needs its own key; deploy.ps1 and doctor.ps1 will start reporting on it automatically. Optional 'plugin' names the Claude Code plugin (an enabledPlugins key in ~/.claude/settings.json) a secret serves: while that plugin is not enabled the secret is not expected and nothing asks for it (Test-SecretApplies in lib/Common.ps1). Both secrets below are optional: everything else works without them.

secrets.name: openrouter-key
secrets.purpose: OpenRouter mode (claude-or, claude-or-sp, claude-or-spsp) -- ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN for the openrouter.ai gateway -- optional, only for OpenRouter-billed sessions

secrets.name: github-token
secrets.purpose: GitHub MCP plugin (loaded into the environment by the claude-functions.ps1 launchers for the session, only while the plugin is enabled; nothing is decrypted at shell start) -- optional
